name: @tessera/workspace
description: Tessera development workspace — self-contained; not part of the shipped servicenow-preflight package

scripts.//: build, test and check are wrapped in scripts/build-lock.mjs, and so is every packages/*/build and packages/*/test. The wrapped paths nest, so the wrapper is re-entrant: it proceeds without acquiring only when the lock file on disk still names the token it inherited AND that holder is alive. Read the RE-ENTRANCY section of scripts/build-lock.mjs before touching any of these; the *:all / *:compile / *:run scripts below are the UNLOCKED halves and are named that way on purpose. A held lock refuses at once (exit 75) by default; set TESSERA_BUILD_LOCK_WAIT=<0..1800> seconds to opt in to a bounded wait for it instead (see the opt-in bounded wait section of scripts/build-lock.mjs).
scripts.build:all: npm run build -w @tessera/types && npm run build -w @tessera/store && npm run build -w @tessera/sn-client && npm run build -w @tessera/guard && npm run build -w @tessera/ledger && npm run build -w @tessera/core && npm run build -w @tessera/fake-instance && npm run build -w @tessera/config && npm run build -w @tessera/doctor && npm run build -w @tessera/parity && npm run build -w @tessera/provisioner && npm run build -w @tessera/resolvers && npm run build -w @tessera/specs && npm run build -w @tessera/impact && npm run build -w @tessera/reporter && npm run build -w @tessera/runner-atf && npm run build -w @tessera/teststore-atf && npm run build -w @tessera/benchmark && npm run build -w @tessera/generate && npm run build -w @tessera/phase05 && npm run build -w @tessera/cli && npm run build -w @tessera/mcp
scripts.//test:all: `&&` here would let one failing workspace suite silently skip test:scripts entirely, so the gate would report a smaller total with no sign that a whole tier never ran. Both halves always run; the worst exit code wins, which keeps the build-lock 75 ahead of an ordinary 1.
scripts.test:all: npm run test --workspaces --if-present; w=$?; npm run test:scripts; s=$?; exit $(( w > s ? w : s ))
scripts.check:all: npm run build && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run test
